title: Physical and Chemical Changes
summary: Is a new substance formed? The one question that tells a melting ice cream apart from a cooking dosa.

ib.note: Revisited in MYP 3 with particle-level explanations

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 5: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical

objectives: I can define physical and chemical changes and give everyday examples of each.
I can use evidence (new substance, colour, gas, energy, reversibility) to classify a change.
I can explain changes using the particle model: rearranged particles vs new particles.
misconceptions: All changes that involve heating are chemical.
Every physical change is easy to reverse (e.g. breaking glass is physical but hard to undo).
If you can't reverse it, it must be chemical.
